status: local development builds; not a release-wide performance claim
endpoint: SCM click to matching file, diff highlights and specified lexical token ready, followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; not physical display presentation time

workload.gitLayout: fixed commit dates and packed objects; automatic GC, maintenance and fsmonitor disabled

rules.cluster: adjacent complete window pairs or triplets; never resample individual clicks
rules.stable: 95% interval upper bound of candidate minus control is below zero and at least 6 of 8 clusters improve
rules.primary: both endToEndMs p95 and p99 must be stable
rules.cold: descriptive only; excluded from warm bootstrap

limitations: Candidate and final cohorts are analyzed separately.
Durations are exported without local paths, request IDs, source content or trace identifiers.
Screenshots, original traces, frozen binaries and the launch/measurement harness are not distributed; this export reproduces statistics, not the complete experiment.
Measurements and runtime correctness checks cover macOS only; other targets were cross-compiled, not measured.

experiments.protocolCohort: final protocol; control and final use the same rebuilt frontend and resources
